exposure: Experience of transgender and gender-diverse (TGD) patients with completing patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) related to gender-affirming care
cohort: The study participants were 14 adult transgender and gender-diverse patients (median age 32.5 years, range 21-60 years) who were seeking or had undergone gender-affirming surgery at a single academic tertiary center.
finding: Adult transgender and gender-diverse patients encounter multiple barriers and facilitators to completing patient-reported outcome measures, including issues with content engagement, administration mode, privacy concerns, fear of negative impact on care, altruism, belief in research value, desire to improve medical care, and access to gender-affirming care.
